Though hospital margin has improved by 530bps over FY23-FY26 to 22.2%, we see further scope for improvement aided by 1) improving case and payor mix, 2) cost rationalization initiatives and ramp-up of Manesar and Greater Noida unit, and 3) new brownfield bed additions.
Additionally, we expect margin to expand further, driven by the recent acquisition of People Tree Hospital, Shrimann Hospital and the O&M agreement with Gleneagles.
